1 · Intro

When to use it.

Non-exempt (weekly/biweekly) pay depends on approved UKG time cards. Managers approve their employees' time; you check time cards weekly and chase managers who are behind.

This course walks through what a manager does in UKG so you can coach them and spot what is blocking pay.

Use this whenA manager asks how to approve time, fix a missed punch, or respond to a time-off request, or a time card is not approved near the pay deadline.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in UKG. Check off each step as you go.

Approval State column
StateWhat it means for you
OpenNot yet submitted or approved; follow up with employee and manager
SubmittedEmployee is done; manager approval is still needed
Approved (PayPrep Ready)Ready for payroll; no action needed

Watch-outs

  • Managers approve; payroll signs off. If a correction is needed after sign-off, contact payroll; the manager cannot simply remove approval.
  • Exempt employees' time off is managed in Oracle, not UKG. Only non-exempt time off is approved in UKG.
  • Open item: confirm the exact manager screens Vanderbilt uses (Manage Timecards, Control Center, schedule views), any delegate approver setup, and the manager approval deadline each pay period.

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Payroll & Timecards

UKG: Timecards, Time Off, and Schedules for Managers

Use when: A manager asks how to approve time, fix a missed punch, or respond to a time-off request, or a time card is not approved near the pay deadline. · System: UKG (Kronos)

  1. Open UKG from Oracle: Me tab > Apps > UKG (Kronos) Timesheets.
  2. Know the approval chain: employee approves, manager approves, payroll signs off.
    • Employee approves own time card
    • Manager approves
    • Payroll signs off
  3. Check the Approval State column for each employee.
  4. Resolve exceptions, such as missed punches, before approving.
  5. Review pending timecard changes the employee submitted.
  6. Approve or refuse time-off requests in Control Center.
  7. View schedules to confirm expected hours.
  8. Follow up weekly until every time card shows Approved.
